decisions.inspectedContentLocation: PMC3084352 / NIHMS272507, PACE architecture, selection coupling, mutagenesis, T7 RNA-polymerase experiments, and Methods (full manuscript)
decisions.reason: PACE continuously evolves T7 RNA polymerase activities and specificity, directly demonstrating directed evolution of an enzyme.
decisions.remediation: None. Preserve the PACE-specific experimental boundary.

decisions.inspectedContentLocation: PMC3084352 / NIHMS272507, PACE architecture, selection coupling, mutagenesis, T7 RNA-polymerase experiments, and Methods (full manuscript)
decisions.reason: The mutagenesis plasmid raises mutation rate and produces diverse mutations during continuous evolution, but the paper does not construct or characterize a discrete mutation library.
decisions.remediation: Narrow to in-process mutagenesis or bind a source that generates and measures an explicit mutation library.

decisions.inspectedContentLocation: PMC3084352 / NIHMS272507, PACE architecture, selection coupling, mutagenesis, T7 RNA-polymerase experiments, and Methods (full manuscript)
decisions.reason: The paper explicitly couples desired target activity to gene-III production and therefore to selection-phage infectivity.
decisions.remediation: None. Preserve the activity-to-infectivity coupling boundary.

decisions.inspectedContentLocation: PMC3084352 / NIHMS272507, PACE architecture, selection coupling, mutagenesis, T7 RNA-polymerase experiments, and Methods (full manuscript)
decisions.reason: The article defines, builds, and experimentally demonstrates phage-assisted continuous evolution.
decisions.remediation: None. Keep this as a technique-specific record.

decisions.inspectedContentLocation: PMC3084352 / NIHMS272507, PACE architecture, selection coupling, mutagenesis, T7 RNA-polymerase experiments, and Methods (full manuscript)
decisions.reason: The authors state that enhanced mutagenesis can traverse single-mutation fitness valleys, but do not map or generally measure fitness-landscape accessibility.
decisions.remediation: Narrow to the demonstrated single-mutation-valley claim or bind a landscape-mapping study.

decisions.inspectedContentLocation: Isaacs et al. 2004 repository PDF, pp. 841–847, design, cis repression, trans activation, figures, and Methods (full article)
decisions.reason: The article constructs a cis-repressed RNA plus a trans-activating RNA. Riboswitches appear only as related prior work; the demonstrated system is not a ligand-responsive riboswitch.
decisions.remediation: Bind a source that constructs and measures synthetic ligand-responsive riboswitches.

decisions.inspectedContentLocation: Isaacs et al. 2004 repository PDF, pp. 841–847, design, cis repression, trans activation, figures, and Methods (full article)
decisions.reason: The complete article does not construct or measure a ligand-binding aptamer domain; activation is driven by complementary RNA.
decisions.remediation: Bind an aptamer-domain or aptazyme source.

decisions.inspectedContentLocation: Isaacs et al. 2004 repository PDF, pp. 841–847, design, cis repression, trans activation, figures, and Methods (full article)
decisions.reason: The demonstrated cis/trans riboregulator is not organized as a ligand-sensing riboswitch expression platform.
decisions.remediation: Bind a source that explicitly separates riboswitch sensor and expression-platform domains.

decisions.inspectedContentLocation: Isaacs et al. 2004 repository PDF, pp. 841–847, design, cis repression, trans activation, figures, and Methods (full article)
decisions.reason: The 2004 paper predates and does not define the later toehold-switch architecture; it demonstrates a different cis/trans RNA regulator.
decisions.remediation: Bind the technique-defining toehold-switch paper.

decisions.inspectedContentLocation: Isaacs et al. 2004 repository PDF, pp. 841–847, design, cis repression, trans activation, figures, and Methods (full article)
decisions.reason: A trans-activating RNA binds the cis-repressed RNA and alters its stem-loop, but the paper does not formulate a general strand-displacement mechanism or circuit formalism.
decisions.remediation: Narrow to trans-RNA-mediated structural activation or bind a strand-displacement source.
